description: We’re a team of 2 looking to accomplish something big.
summary: Our project is an interactive storytelling website designed to make space exploration more engaging and fun for younger audiences. Using NASA research, users can explore different locations in space, discover spacecraft and rovers, learn about their scientific contributions, and read the journey they'll be exploring through timelines. Our goal is to turn space research into an enjoyable experience that encourages curiosity and makes learning about space more interesting.
details:
Project Overview

Our project is an interactive storytelling website that allows users to discover NASA's spacecraft, rovers and other space equipment projects through a digital experience.

Main Features

  • Interactive Radar: Displays different locations across space
  • Spacecraft and Rover Selection: Allows users to select individual machines and begin exploring.
  • Mission Stories: Provides information about each machine's purpose, discoveries, contributions, mission duration, and current status.
  • Timelines: Shows important events throughout each mission, from launch to its current status or final mission.

What makes our project creative?

What makes it creative is the way it combines real NASA research with interactive storytelling. We wanted to present scientific information in a way that feels more enjoyable and fun than traditional ways, allowing users to discover each mission at their own pace.

Purpose

The website is designed for children and young people who are curious about space but find traditional learning materials boring. By combining real research with interactive storytelling and visuals, we hope to make space exploration easier and more enjoyable to understand.

Future Development

We hope to introduce more locations, additional NASA equipment, and more detailed scientific explanations, including topics such as spacecraft trajectories and so on.

Tools
Our website was developed using HTML, alongside C++/Python. We used NASA's publicly available research and resources to provide accurate information about each mission..
